# M32 Trainer corpus — draft for review

*Generated by `Software/tools/trainer-corpus/build_corpus.py` (edit the sources, not this file). For Willi's review (decision 12c); tier C also gets a second operator's look.*

**What to look for:** correct CW idiom and abbreviations, prosign use, natural plain language, nothing odd or offensive, and whether the lesson bands make sense.

| Tier | Source | Items |
|---|---|---|
| A — words, word chains | `english_words.h` (Oxford-based list) | 4881 words |
| B — plain language | written for the trainer (`tier_b_en.txt`) | 150 |
| B — plain language | Tommy OZ1THC's `phrases_2/3/4_words.txt` | 240 |
| B — plain language | Willi's list (`tier_b_willi_en.txt`) | 95 |
| C — QSO | fragments of `RealQSOs.TXT` (G0ELZ, G3DVW) | 1675 |
| C — QSO | templates with slots (`tier_c_en.txt`) | 94 |

## Coverage — usable items per lesson

Counted with the strict Koch filter (decision 13a): every character of the item is in the first *n* characters of the sequence. *Words* = tier A (single words; word chains are drawn from the same words). A template counts when its fixed text and at least one value for each slot are usable (a call sign: when the generator can make one from a common prefix with the characters learned so far). A tier is offered at a lesson once it has 10 usable items (decision 13b).

## Tier C — QSO lines

### Fragments of RealQSOs.TXT (1675)

Each QSO cut at `=` (BT); kept when 2–8 words. `<AR>` became `+`, run-together prosigns were split (`<AR><KN>` → `+ <kn>`, `<AR>SK` and `<AR>VA` → `+ <sk>`, `<AR>2M0RTZ` → `+ 2m0rtz`), `?` joined to its word. Dropped:

- duplicate: 1397
- not 2-8 words: 1221
- cut off (ends on "qth/name/is/..."): 361
- a prosign run into a word: 13
- a word over 14 characters: 1
